items.title: Akron Zoo Opens $10 Million Veterinary Hospital for Expanded In-House Animal Care
items.summary: The Akron Zoo opened its new Tom and Shelley Koutnik Center for Veterinary Care, a $10 million, 11,949-square-foot hospital that brings nearly all daily animal care in-house, including surgeries, quarantine, and specialized enclosures. The facility replaces the outdated Sherman Center veterinary space and supports the zoo's growing population of over 2,000 animals. For visitors, this means improved animal health and welfare, though the hospital itself is not a public exhibit.

items.title: Summit Metro Parks extends final offer in Szalay farmland negotiations
items.summary: Summit Metro Parks has extended its final offer in negotiations with the Szalay family over farmland where Native American relics were discovered. The extension gives both parties more time to reach an agreement, and the outcome will determine whether the park system can preserve the culturally significant site. For visitors, this could affect future access to the land and any planned archaeological or educational programs.
